verdict.rationale: The Ryzen AI Software stack documents programmatic interfaces for this processor: a first-party Ryzen AI CVML C++ API, ONNX Runtime C++/Python APIs via the Vitis AI EP, and an LLM server interface that applications in any language can integrate with. Much of this surface is built on third-party runtimes (ONNX Runtime, Lemonade). There is no published API spec (all OpenAPI probes returned 404), and driving the chip's own controls (cTDP, voltage offsets) is not shown to be exposed through an API. missing for 10: a published machine-readable API specification, a documented API for hardware/device management beyond inference, and independent hands-on corroboration of the API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Each Ryzen AI CVML library feature offers a simple C++ application programming interface (API) that can be easily incorporated into existing applications.
This allows applications written in any language (C#, JavaScript, Python, C++, etc.) to easily integrate with Ryzen AI LLMs.
The AI model is deployed using the ONNX Runtime with either C++ or Python APIs.
